title: Sources: DeepSeek and Moonshot are among the companies briefing the UN Security Council on AI risks and international security during the UN General Assembly (Laurie Chen/Reuters)
summary: Laurie Chen / Reuters: Sources: DeepSeek and Moonshot are among the companies briefing the UN Security Council on AI risks and international security during the UN General Assembly — Chinese AI startup DeepSeek will be among the companies briefing the United Nations Security Council this week on the risks posed …
